card.name: Linking words before immunocompromised
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'are', 'in', 'being' or 'severely' that come just before the word immunocompromised or a similar term about weakened immunity. Seen in antifungal and PML warning text.

modes.label: Who are / being
modes.description: Verb or adverb right before 'immunocompromised' in a description of at-risk patients.
modes.example: due to<< being>> severely immunocompromised. This is

modes.label: Occurs in patients
modes.description: The word 'in' or 'are' leading into a patient group with weakened immunity.
modes.example: typically only occurs<< in>> patients who are immunocompromised,

modes.label: Infections in neutropenic patients
modes.description: 'in' before a patient group with low white cell counts.
modes.example: Presumed Fungal Infections<< in>> Febrile Neutropenic Patients
